headline: The era curve: Civ V tourism now bends with the ages
lede: Brave New World's defining culture law lands on the shelf — your visitor book counts double against every rival stuck in an older age, and one PR shipped the rule, the panel badges, and 22 new proofs with it.

notes.text: PAPERS, PLEASE-MIN 'papers in hand' shipped — drag the passport and ID with your finger across the counter; press-drag lifts with a rustle and tilt, release drops it where it lands, and the next applicant's drop clears the desk. #2120.

CIVILIZATION V: the culture crown reads tourism x2 per era of lead against each living rival (Brave New World's curve). The 120 threshold stays raw — same-era strictness byte-identical — and a crown bought by the age gap is named in the copy.

civcheck is 662 green with a new section proving the curve both directions: 120 doubled beats 239 but not 240, a cradle age never inflates, dead empires' ghost books can't haunt the crown. Two mutants died for it.

A game string is never in the entry bundle: production verification greps the lazy chunks pulled from it. A perl one-liner that silently read STDIN was nearly reported as a passing mutant — no diff after planting means no mutant.
